scientific_integrity: All identities and p-rank calculations are proved symbolically; exhaustive F7 tests are corroborative and not substituted for geometric proofs. Bibliographic coverage is based on accessible primary material and targeted searches, not an independence claim.
scientific_limitations: The complete stratification is for the explicitly normalized two-parameter genus-four hyperelliptic family over the algebraic closure of F7, not all genus-four curves or all C6 automorphism families; five counts parameter pairs, not geometric isomorphism classes; Newton polygons and full Ekedahl-Oort types are not determined.
title: The five \(p\)-rank-one parameters of a genus-four cyclic-symmetry family in characteristic seven
